title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency […]
title_es: FCC autoriza a SpaceX desplegar 1 millón de satélites de IA en órbita
bajada: La FCC aprobó el plan de SpaceX para lanzar hasta 1 millón de satélites equipados con chips de IA como parte de la iniciativa "Starmind". Esta aprobación abre la puerta a una nueva infraestructura de computación en el espacio, compitiendo con iniciativas similares de Google y Blue Origin.
bajada_en: The FCC approved SpaceX's plan to deploy up to 1 million AI-equipped satellites as part of its "Starmind" initiative. This approval opens the door to new space-based computing infrastructure, competing with similar initiatives from Google and Blue Origin.

title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
title_es: GPT-6 demuestra capacidades intrínsecas de diseño de proteínas
bajada: OpenAI publicó investigación mostrando que los modelos GPT-6 pueden realizar diseño de proteínas sin entrenamiento específico. Este resultado sugiere que los modelos de lenguaje avanzados están desarrollando capacidades transversales inesperadas con aplicaciones potenciales en biología computacional.
bajada_en: OpenAI published research showing GPT-6 models can perform protein design without specialized training. This result suggests advanced language models are developing unexpected cross-domain capabilities with potential applications in computational biology.

title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
title_es: OpenAI implementa medidor de uso unificado al fusionar Chat y Work
bajada: OpenAI unificará los límites de uso entre ChatGPT Chat y ChatGPT Work en un único medidor, lo que significa que usuarios intensivos podrían alcanzar sus límites más rápidamente. Este cambio afecta directamente a los usuarios que dependen de ambos productos.
bajada_en: OpenAI will unify usage limits between ChatGPT Chat and Work into a single meter, meaning heavy users could hit limits sooner. This change directly impacts users relying on both products.

title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
summary: A new test assumes AI agents can go rogue—and asks whether they can resist temptation.
title_es: Anthropic crea trampa para probar comportamiento de agentes de IA
bajada: Anthropic desarrolló un método de prueba tipo honeypot para evaluar si los agentes de IA pueden resistir la tentación de comportarse incorrectamente. Este trabajo es fundamental para entender la seguridad y confiabilidad de los agentes autónomos.
bajada_en: Anthropic developed a honeypot-style testing method to evaluate whether AI agents can resist the temptation to misbehave. This work is fundamental to understanding the safety and reliability of autonomous agents.

title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
title_es: Nueva York prohíbe juguetes de IA por cinco años tras fallos de seguridad
bajada: Nueva York implementó una prohibición de cinco años sobre juguetes de chatbot con IA después que investigaciones revelaron exposición a contenido inapropiado y riesgos para el desarrollo emocional. Esta regulación representa el primer paso de gobiernos locales contra productos de IA de consumo no seguros.
bajada_en: New York implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys after research revealed exposure to inappropriate content and emotional development risks. This regulation represents the first step by local governments against unsafe consumer AI products.

title: S&P Global Puts Nvidia on ‘CreditWatch Negative’ Due to Governance Risks
summary: S&P Global, one of the three big credit rating agencies, placed Nvidia’s credit rating on “CreditWatch Negative” on Wednesday, citing rising management and governance risks. The action means the agency will review Nvidia’s credit rating and could downgrade it in the next 90 days.S&P ...
title_es: S&P Global coloca a Nvidia bajo vigilancia negativa por riesgos de gobernanza
bajada: La agencia de calificación S&P Global puso a Nvidia bajo revisión en la categoría 'CreditWatch Negative' por riesgos de gobernanza e indemnización de ejecutivos clave. Nvidia podría enfrentar una degradación de su calificación crediticia en los próximos 90 días.
bajada_en: Credit rating agency S&P Global placed Nvidia under 'CreditWatch Negative' review due to governance risks and key executive dependency. Nvidia could face a credit rating downgrade within 90 days.

title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
title_es: Dario Amodei rechaza acusaciones sobre control humano en IA
bajada: El CEO de Anthropic defendió la posición de la compañía ante acusaciones de que favorece entregar el control a la IA, en medio de un debate más amplio sobre automatización en desarrollo de modelos. El tema refleja tensiones crecientes sobre gobernanza en la industria.
bajada_en: Anthropic's CEO defended the company's position against accusations that it favors surrendering control to AI, amid broader debate about automation in model development. The issue reflects growing tensions over AI governance in the industry.

title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
summary: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue. As reported by Fortune, […]
title_es: Amazon negocia permitir que Muse de Meta compre en su plataforma
bajada: Amazon estaría en conversaciones para levantar su bloqueo al agente de compra Muse de Meta, enfocándose en qué productos recomienda y el impacto en ingresos publicitarios. Este movimiento podría marcar un cambio importante en cómo los retailers integran agentes de IA de terceros.
bajada_en: Amazon is reportedly negotiating to lift its block on Meta's Muse shopping agent, focusing on product recommendations and advertising revenue impact. This move could mark a significant shift in how retailers integrate third-party AI agents.

title: firecrawl /firecrawl
summary: 🔥 Firecrawl Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three. Firecrawl Local . Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost. Firecrawl Cloud . Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone. Self-hosting . Deploy the full Firecrawl server from apps/api with its own queues, workers and databases on your own infrastructure. Pst. Hey, you, join our stargazers :) Firecrawl Local Firecrawl Local scrapes, crawls and maps from your own machine without a database, queue or container, and it reaches Firecrawl Cloud when your AI agents need search or Alexandria. It installs from crates.io. You need Rust and a C compiler, which on macOS means xcode-select --install and on Debian or Ubuntu means build-essential . cargo install firecrawl-local If you don't have Rust, Firecrawl Cloud runs the same scrape with nothing to build and no signup. npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest scrape https://firecrawl.dev Scrape a page and print its markdown. firecrawl-local scrape https://firecrawl.dev --markdown Crawl a site and save one markdown file per page. firecrawl-local crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev --limit 50 --out ./pages List every URL on a site. firecrawl-local map https://firecrawl.dev Pages that need JavaScript render in the Chrome or Chromium already on your machine, and PDFs and Office documents are parsed locally too. Without a browser, static pages still work and a page that needed one comes back with a warning. Add it to your AI agent init finds Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI and Codex on your machine and adds Firecrawl Loca
title_es: Firecrawl: infraestructura open-source para potenciar agentes de IA
bajada: Firecrawl es una herramienta open-source que convierte sitios web en markdown limpio y se integra con agentes de IA mediante servidores MCP. Ofrece versiones local, cloud y auto-hospedada, facilitando que los desarrolladores proporcionen contexto web a sus agentes.
bajada_en: Firecrawl is an open-source tool that converts websites to clean markdown and integrates with AI agents via MCP servers. It offers local, cloud, and self-hosted versions, making it easier for developers to provide web context to their agents.

title: openvinotoolkit /openvino
summary: Open-source software toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models. Broad Platform Compatibility : Reduce resource demands and efficiently deploy on a range of platforms from edge to cloud. title_es: OpenVINO: toolkit open-source para optimización de modelos de IA
bajada: OpenVINO es un toolkit de Intel que optimiza e implementa modelos de deep learning en múltiples plataformas desde edge hasta cloud. Soporta frameworks populares como PyTorch, TensorFlow y modelos de Hugging Face, permitiendo inference eficiente en CPUs, GPUs y aceleradores.
bajada_en: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models across platforms from edge to cloud. It supports popular frameworks and Hugging Face models, enabling efficient inference on CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators.
